WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints_2024
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND opened_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips_2024
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  c.complaints_2024 AS complaints,
  t.trips_2024 AS trips,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints_2024 / t.trips_2024, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM c CROSS JOIN t;
notes: Assumes the rate is total 2024 complaints (all provider types, including Non-Transportation) divided by total 2024 completed trips (all provider types and boroughs), scaled per 1,000, since the two tables use different provider-type labels and a provider-matched rate would need a mapping.

    CASE WHEN isodow(service_date) IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
    trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'

)

  SUM(trips) AS completed_trips,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(trips) / SUM(SUM(trips)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_trips
FROM t
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY day_type;
